d: A young veteran and new father is stretched thin trying to grow his landscaping business until Dr. Phil and HighLevel step in to help him reclaim his time and scale smarter.
A female master plumber is overwhelmed by the demands of her business and turns to Dr. Phil and HighLevel to streamline operations and take back control.
A newlywed tells his wife that he wants a six-to-12-month trial marriage  a man contemplates postponing the wedding to his fiancée, who is recovering from bulimia.

Legal analyst Lisa Bloom and District Attorney Kathleen Rice weigh in on the tragic car accident caused by drunken driver Diane Schuler  a mother of two admits she has consumed alcohol before getting behind the wheel.
Dr. Phil counsels a couple on the verge of divorce  attorney Areva Martin discusses protecting oneself during the process of divorce.
A bride gets ready for her 11th wedding  Dr. Phil gives advice to couples preparing for their big day.

st: Young, Privileged and in a Deadly Gang
d: The family of a 16-year-old gang member urges him to turn his life around  two former gang members have an important message for him.

st: David Grusch: The Whistleblower Who Told Congress We're Not Alone
d: The intelligence officer turned whistleblower stunned the world by testifying under oath that the U.S. government recovered a craft of nonhuman origin  Dr. Phil explores the courage, cost and psychology of the man who risked it all to tell the truth.

st: Did the US Government Successfully Luro UFOs?
d: Dr. Phil sits down with a congressman who says he was briefed that the U.S. secretly learned to lure these craft down out of the sky, and a researcher who says the proof is already hiding in the government's own files.
